label: PF Backlog 515
title: Tuning: default PF_ID_BLOCK_SIZE=1 (sequential one id per CAS request, no gaps)
body:
## Problem / why
Block reservation (size 100) made ids jump ~100 per new session, which is surprising for PF's own backlog.

## Goal & value
Default PF_ID_BLOCK_SIZE=1 so each backlog-number request gets the NEXT sequential id via the shared git-CAS
authority - no gaps (session1 -> 1067, session2 -> 1068).

## Acceptance criteria
- PF_ID_BLOCK_SIZE default is 1 (env-flags declared); id_allocator block_size() defaults to 1.
- Each add_epic reserves exactly one id via the CAS (one push per item).
- Raise PF_ID_BLOCK_SIZE for bulk creation.

## Out of scope
Changing the CAS mechanism.

## Verification
id allocator tests green with default block size 1.
